what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Zoom only (Meeting ID 766 316 7607, link printed on the agenda: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7663167607?omn=8363007219); recorded and broadcast later on Lunenburg Public Access cable, its Facebook page, and YouTube within 24 hours.

items.agenda_line: a. In Consideration of Passing Over Article 9 of the Special Town Meeting Warrant
items.why_it_matters: The committee may vote on whether to pass over Article 9, which asks the Town to appropriate $195,830 for engineering and related services for a proposed reconstruction of the Middle/High School track and field (submitted by the School Committee).

items.agenda_line: 2.   Public Comment for Prior Issues (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: Residents may have a chance to speak on earlier issues at this special meeting.

items.agenda_line: 5. Public Comment for Issues Discussed Tonight
items.why_it_matters: Residents may comment on the Article 9 item after it is discussed.

preview.hook: Whether to pass over the $195,830 track and field engineering article on the Special Town Meeting warrant
preview.one_line: Special meeting, Monday Nov. 16 at 7:00 PM on Zoom: the School Committee considers passing over Article 9, $195,830 for Middle/High School track and field engineering.
